issues.title: Ingest Montgomery County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $10,373,163 across 30 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($3,209,164), County Road Department ($3,002,511), Law Enforcement Sales Tax ($1,643,697). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
